description: This file defines the MobileInput class, which extends VirtualInput to handle mobile platform-specific input methods in a cross-platform game. It registers virtual buttons and axes, and provides methods to set and get their states, as well as retrieve the mouse position.

classes.name: MobileInput
classes.description: A class extending VirtualInput, providing mobile-specific input handling including registering and querying virtual axes and buttons.

methods.name: AddButton
methods.description: Registers a virtual button with the specified name if not already registered.

methods.name: AddAxes
methods.description: Registers a virtual axis with the specified name if not already registered.

methods.name: GetAxis
methods.description: Returns the current value of the specified axis, registering it if necessary.

methods.name: SetButtonDown
methods.description: Marks the virtual button as pressed.

methods.name: SetButtonUp
methods.description: Marks the virtual button as released.

methods.name: SetAxisPositive
methods.description: Sets the specified axis to a positive value.

methods.name: SetAxisNegative
methods.description: Sets the specified axis to a negative value.

methods.name: SetAxisZero
methods.description: Resets the specified axis to zero.

methods.name: SetAxis
methods.description: Sets the specified axis to a particular float value.

methods.name: GetButtonDown
methods.description: Returns whether the specified button was just pressed.

methods.name: GetButtonUp
methods.description: Returns whether the specified button was just released.

methods.name: GetButton
methods.description: Returns whether the specified button is currently held down.

methods.name: MousePosition
methods.description: Returns the current mouse position as a Vector3.
